summary: Postoperative encounter for neurostimulator pulse-generator insertion/replacement and rectocele repair with biological graft, with urinary retention and anaphylactic reaction documented. Urine collected during this encounter grew multidrug-resistant Citrobacter freundii complex, finalized after discharge, supporting contact precautions; MRSA screening was negative. No ongoing invasive respiratory support, IV drips, vascular lines, or tubes are documented; cervical cancer is remote history without evidence of current immunosuppression.
contact_isolation_reason: Encounter urine culture grew Citrobacter freundii complex resistant to ceftriaxone/ceftazidime, gentamicin, and trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole, supporting multidrug-resistant organism contact precautions.
